tips.text: Buy extra Blueprint relics from Varzia; it is the Rare part in every one of them and the usual bottleneck.
Bank Aya before Varzia's window opens; neither Aya nor relics you hold expire when her stock rotates.
Radshare Radiant relics for the Rares; refine only the Rare-carrying relics and leave Common ones Intact.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
Buy her relics from the Market's Prime Resurgence tab to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
